title: A posted review record always parses
why: Review records on #1502 and #1535 had prose after the CI line, so merge.parse_review returned None and they were fixed by hand.
note: Fix: a guard on a PR comment holding `<!-- review-record -->` (gh or MCP) runs parse_review and refuses on None; or merge.py --review-record posts the record itself. Done check: a guard test refuses a record with trailing prose and allows the bare record.
